reward: wealth change throughout; the reward axis is not varied here

S0.limitation: cannot tell whether it holds anything, or whether it can afford to buy

S1.limitation: knows the unit count but not what that position is worth

S2.limitation: knows its financial position but not where it is in the episode

S3a.limitation: market context is still a single lagged return

S3.limitation: no memory of the path taken to the current wealth

S4.limitation: no volume or regime information; no cross-asset context

S5.limitation: order flow, news and other participants remain unobserved

B1a_slice_bah.description: buy one slice whenever legal, at the agent's granularity

B1b_true_bah.description: fully invested at the first bar, held to liquidation

B2_random.description: uniform over legal actions, single generator across months
